scientific_question: Does SparkBrain's native No-Ignition gate provide selective decision value beyond an ordinary target-blind confidence-abstention head built from the same score vector, on fresh noisy/unresolved controlled worlds?

independent_motivation.hypothesis: H4 — No-ignition is a valuable computational state

candidate.name: SparkBrain native No-Ignition
candidate.dynamics: unchanged default BrainConfig plus existing build_reference_brain

comparator.name: coverage-matched ordinary confidence abstention head
comparator.input_privilege: same per-step LABELS probability vector exposed by the frozen runner
comparator.decision_label: deterministic argmax probability with canonical LABELS-order tie break
comparator.thresholds: one scalar per world selected on target-free DEV to match native candidate coverage

threshold_selection.candidate_set: all unique DEV max-probability values plus +infinity and -infinity sentinels
threshold_selection.tie_break: choose the larger threshold, then numeric order

primary_metric.name: equal-world-weighted selective decision loss
primary_metric.episode_loss: mean per-step loss over exactly 30 steps
primary_metric.world_loss: mean episode loss over exactly 512 TEST episodes
primary_metric.overall_loss: arithmetic mean of the three world losses
primary_metric.effect: comparator_overall_loss - candidate_overall_loss; positive favors native No-Ignition

statistics.stratification: resample 512 episode identities with replacement independently within each world, then equal-weight the three world means

classification.coverage_guard: absolute TEST coverage difference between candidate and comparator must be <= 0.03 in every world
classification.PASS_NATIVE_NO_IGNITION_ADDS_SELECTIVE_V: coverage guard passes AND effect_ci95_lower >= 0.02 AND every world point effect > 0
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: all other valid outcomes, including coverage guard failure

secondary_diagnostics_not_claim_gating: candidate and comparator loss by world
integrity_order: same-final-SHA ordinary CI and dedicated pre-START green
fresh identity and namespace collision check
independent remote re-fetch and digest/cardinality verification
unique total fail-closed join on world/seed/step_index

raw_contract.target_blind_generator_requirement: formal acquisition must expose only observations and latent-free identifiers; hidden world truth may exist only inside the deterministic generator and must never be returned to candidate/comparator/scorer before preservation

post_start_failure_policy: identity consumed; terminal STOP; no retry, repair, salvage, threshold retuning, or automatic NI01-v2
